directive.quote: finish the trillion-launch-video port so the repo can be retired

targets.baseline_commit_message: grade-and-repair-speech-audio: byte copies of the speech-grading plan reader and the voice-take checks (port baseline)

preserve: per word: pyin pitch at 5 ms hops, jumps over 3 semitones per hop counted as pitch breaks
clicks are the waveform's second difference against the local 10 ms RMS, flagged above 6
stretched words are seconds per letter over 2.6 times the take's median
periodicity is the median normalised autocorrelation peak (55-250 Hz lags) over 40 ms frames above -45 dBFS
<take>.qc.json holds one row per word; the flagged words and the worst five of each measure are printed
banned_substitutions: thresholds read from a person's settings: they are what a human voice cannot do
_old_copy: The old copy leaves the private repository on its own branch once the Mac parity run (out/speech/mac-parity) says EQUAL.
